compact-risk-levels.pass: Risk is low, medium, high or excluded (scar tissue or unknown origin, which cannot be proposed).
compact-risk-levels.fail: Rank them by lines saved, biggest first.

compact-apply.pass: No. Propose only; the user confirms each item by number, and each applied item is one commit each, after its guard exists.
compact-apply.fail: Yes, apply all low-risk removals in a single cleanup commit.

compact-excluded.pass: It goes in the Excluded table with its audit row number and why it stays.
compact-excluded.fail: Treat unknown code as dead and propose removing it as high risk.
